# Cyryx Labs

> Cyryx Labs builds proprietary AI products, custom AI systems, and governed agentic workflows for teams operationalizing AI.

Cyryx Labs is the execution layer for operational AI. We design and ship AI products, agentic workflow systems, and execution infrastructure — anchored by MAAX Studio, our runtime-first agentic execution environment powered by the MAAX Runtime.
